summary: Keurig Dr Pepper filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, announcing the appointment of Russ Torres as CEO of its Coffee Operating Unit and future CEO of Global Coffee Co., effective November 3, 2026. Torres, currently President and COO of Kimberly-Clark, joins to lead integration of KDP's coffee operations with JDE Peet's ahead of the planned early-2027 separation into Global Coffee Co. and Beverage Co. He will report to CEO Tim Cofer and join the future coffee board. The announcement names no deal terms, premium, or advisor, and the separation itself remains subject to completion. Watch for separation timing, JDE Peet's integration progress, and executive-transition risk around the split.
